2608.19993.title: Optimal Skill Selection for LLM Agents with Provable Bicriteria Guarantees
2608.19993.paper_summary: Loading reusable skill documents into a bounded context window is now the primary way large language model (LLM) agents acquire task-specific capabilities, which makes skill selection a first-order determinant of task performance and token cost. Yet current agents score skills independently by semantic relevance and assemble the set by top-$k$ or greedy packing, with no quality guarantee or cost awareness on the selected set. As a result, redundant or poorly chosen skills waste scarce context tokens and can even degrade performance. We give the first model of how the selected skill set shapes execution outcomes and cast skill selection as an optimization problem: choose a skill set under a hard token budget to maximize a monotone submodular benefit minus context penalty. For this problem, we develop Best Prefix Selection (BPS), a polynomial-time algorithm, and prove, to our knowledge, the first performance guarantee for skill selection: a bicriteria $(1-1/e,1)$ approximation whose benefit coefficient is optimal in polynomial time. On a contamination-controlled BigCodeBench variant, BPS outperforms all the baselines, reaching $0.73$ measured task success versus $0.20$--$0.52$ for released skill routers, text retrievers, and the executor's own selection, on $28\%$ fewer tokens than the strongest released router.
2608.19993.paper_summary_zh: 將可重用的技能文檔加載到有限上下文窗口中，現在是大型語言模型（LLM）代理獲取任務特定能力的主要方式，這使得技能選擇成為任務表現和代幣成本的首要決定因素。<lb/>然而，目前的代理根據語義相關性獨立評分技能，並通過 top-$k$ 或貪婪打包組合技能集，對所選集沒有質量保證或成本意識。<lb/>因此，多餘或選擇不當的技能浪費了稀缺的上下文代幣，甚至可能降低性能。<lb/>我們首次建立了所選技能集如何影響執行結果的模型，並將技能選擇視為一個優化問題：在嚴格的代幣預算下選擇技能集，以最大化單調子模的收益減去上下文懲罰。<lb/>對於這個問題，我們開發了最佳前綴選擇（BPS），這是一個多項式時間算法，並首次證明了技能選擇的性能保證：一個雙標準 $(1-1/e,1)$ 近似，其收益係數在多項式時間內是最佳的。<lb/>在一個受污染控制的 BigCodeBench 變體上，BPS 超越了所有基線，達到 $0.73$ 的任務成功率，而釋放的技能路由器、文本檢索器和執行者自己的選擇則為 $0.20$--$0.52$，使用的代幣數量比最強的釋放路由器少 $28\%$。
